name: tvs
columns: __comment_ipp__: peak pulse current is the surge spec MOST TVS parts actually
carry (~40% vs ~27% for Ppp): 'Peak Pulse Current (Ipp)@10/1000us' 197/500,
'Peak Pulse Current (Ipp)' 71/500, plus 8/20us variants — all substring-matched
by 'Peak Pulse Current'. NOTE the waveform (10/1000us vs 8/20us) is folded into
one column; for a shortlist that distinction lives in the datasheet anyway.
__comment_direction__: REWORKED 2026-07-07 — the old text 'direction' column was
74% NULL and its populated values were junk: alias 'Unidirectional Channels'
returned the CHANNEL COUNT ('1'), and the 'Type' fallback returned 'TVS'/'ESD'.
Now a ternary flag: 1 = bidirectional, 0 = unidirectional, NULL = unknown.
plus description scavenging (~7.6k of 15.5k parts state it in the text).
__comment_n_channels__: 'Number of Lines' is the real numeric key (56/500).
